mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW 6 Series 630i engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rebuilt engine for a BMW 630i typically costs £3,500-£5,500 supply-only depending on the generation and engine code. Used units start from £800, reconditioned from £2,125. Fitting adds approximately 10-14 hours of labour at specialist rates.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of water pump failure in a BMW E63/E64 630i?

acceptedAnswer.text: The N52 engine in the E63/E64 630i (2003-2007) is prone to electric water pump failure. Warning signs include the engine temperature gauge rising into the red zone, the cabin heater blowing cold air, and the cooling fan running at full speed continuously.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a BMW E63/E64 630i?

acceptedAnswer.text: The E63/E64 630i (2003-2010) is a modern classic with a loyal following. A well-maintained example is worth £3,000-£8,000. If the car is solid and the replacement cost makes financial sense, many owners choose to invest in a quality rebuild.

mainEntity.name: How long does a BMW 630i engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical BMW 630i engine replacement takes 2-3 days for a specialist workshop, including removal, fitting, and testing. Supply-only delivery is usually 1-3 working days. Complexity varies by generation.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the BMW 630i engines across generations?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 630i badge has covered three main engine variants: the N52B30 3.0-litre naturally aspirated straight-six with 258hp (E63/E64 630Ci, 2003-2007), the N53B30 3.0-litre direct-injection straight-six with 272hp (E63/E64 630i, 2007-2010), and the B48B20 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder with 258hp (G32 630i, 2017-2023).

mainEntity.name: What warranty comes with a BMW 630i replacement engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every rebuilt or reconditioned BMW 630i engine supplied through EnginesMarket carries a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Some suppliers offer extended coverage on premium rebuilds. Always confirm exact terms with your chosen supplier.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW 6 Series 630i - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The BMW 630i has been the entry-level petrol model across three generations of the 6 Series, offering accessible straight-six and, later, turbocharged four-cylinder power. From the naturally aspirated N52 of the E63/E64 through to the efficient B48 of the G32 Gran Turismo, the 630i badge has always represented the sweet spot between performance and economy in BMW's grand tourer range.

milestones.description: **2003** - E63/E64 630Ci launched with N52B30 3.0-litre naturally aspirated straight-six, 258hp, 300Nm torque
**2007** - E63/E64 facelift introduces N53B30 3.0-litre direct-injection straight-six, 272hp, replacing the N52 in markets with low-sulphur fuel
**2011** - F12/F13 6 Series launched - 630i not offered in the UK market; replaced by 640i (N55 3.0L turbo straight-six, 320hp)
**2017** - G32 6 Series Gran Turismo launched with B48B20 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder, 258hp, 400Nm, paired with 8-speed automatic
**2023** - G32 6 Series Gran Turismo production ends

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the BMW 6 Series 630i is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: BMW 6 Series 630i Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW 630i's engines vary dramatically by generation - the N52 is generally considered the most dependable choice in the E63/E64 lineup, while the N53 suffers from high-pressure fuel pump failures, and the B48 is a modern, efficient unit with fewer issues. Rebuilt 630i engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: N52 Electric Water Pump Failure - Why the BMW 6 Series E63/E64 630i Overheats
problems.rootCause: The N52's electric water pump is a known weak point. Unlike belt-driven pumps, the electric unit can fail without warning, leading to rapid overheating and potential head gasket or cylinder head damage.

repairOptions.longevity: Only if caught early and damage is minor
When overheating has caused catastrophic damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical E63/E64 630i (2003-2010) is worth roughly £3,000-£8,000 depending on condition and mileage. If you're facing a full rebuilt engine at £3,500-£4,500 plus fitting, the replacement cost may approach 50-60% of a lower-value example's market value. For well-maintained, low-mileage examples, the maths is more favourable.
problems.recommendation: Preventative water pump replacement is significantly cheaper than dealing with the aftermath of an overheat. If your E63/E64 630i's cooling system hasn't been refreshed, consider replacing the water pump and thermostat proactively. If the car has overheated, have the cylinder head inspected immediately - catching a minor warp early can save the engine.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt N52B30 BMW 6 Series 630i engine prices

problems.h4: N53 High-Pressure Fuel Pump Failure - Power Loss in the BMW 6 Series E63/E64 630i
problems.rootCause: The N53's high-pressure fuel pump is the most notorious failure point on this engine. Symptoms include rough idling, stalling, a noticeable drop in power, and an "Engine fault! Reduced power" warning. Many early failures were replaced under recall, but later failures remain common.

repairOptions.longevity: If injectors are failing alongside HPFP
When HPFP failure has caused internal damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Same as above - E63/E64 630i values typically £3,000-£8,000. HPFP replacement at £900-£1,500 is usually a viable option if the rest of the engine is sound. However, if the failure has caused internal damage or multiple systems have failed, replacement may be the only sensible route.
problems.recommendation: HPFP failure on the N53 is well-documented and often strikes without warning. If you experience rough idling or power loss, have the fuel system diagnosed promptly. Catching a failing HPFP early can prevent damage to the catalytic converter and other components. For cars with high mileage or multiple issues, a fully rebuilt engine with upgraded components and warranty offers the best value.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt N53B30 BMW 6 Series 630i engine prices

problems.h4: B48 Timing Chain Tensioner Wear - Rattling in the BMW 6 Series G32 630i
problems.rootCause: The B48 engine, while more reliable than its N20 predecessor, can suffer from timing chain tensioner wear, particularly on pre-2018 models. A rattling noise on startup lasting more than three seconds is the primary warning sign.

repairOptions.longevity: If rattling on startup is detected early
If tensioner failure has caused chain stretch
When chain has failed or caused internal damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical G32 630i (2017-2023) is worth roughly £12,000-£25,000 depending on condition and mileage. Replacement cost is typically well within vehicle value, making a rebuilt engine a viable option if needed. However, preventative maintenance is always the better value.
problems.recommendation: If your G32 630i's B48 engine makes a rattling noise on startup lasting more than three seconds, have the timing chain tensioner inspected immediately. Catching it early can save the engine. For pre-2018 models, consider preventative tensioner replacement as a cost-effective insurance policy against catastrophic failure.
